name: Amharic
caution: 13.5 million words, versus hundreds of millions for the main languages. Frequency values are unreliable, so there are no frequency bands, only the all-words generators. The reference lexicon has 170,299 words, so generators, neighbourhood measures and cluster filters are rougher than for the main languages. Ethiopic is a syllabary: every character is a consonant plus a vowel (CV), except the sixth-order characters (ን ት ስ …), which are a bare consonant or a consonant with an epenthetic vowel and are counted as C. Vowel-initial syllables are written with the glottal series (አ ኡ ኢ …) and therefore count as CV. Length is counted in characters (fidel).

source: Leipzig Corpora Collection word list amh_wikipedia_2021_30K (CC BY; Goldhahn, Eckart & Quasthoff 2012)

english_contamination_removed.rule: Leipzig-only words of 5+ letters that are English words with Zipf >= 4.5

reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: 2 x the number of training words, between 5000 and 100000; a generator stops early when fewer than 1 in 20 recent samples is new and legal

multi_source.rule: a word found in only one of the 2 sources although 3+ occurrences were expected in the others (from its frequency) does not train the generators

uncased_names.rule: word romanised and matched with a name found capitalised-only in at least 12 other corpora (translit.py)

patches.what: removed 2117 bank items that sound like a real word (same-sounding letters merged)

realword_filter.rule: a bank item is dropped if a Hunspell dictionary (affixes on, compounding off, lower-case or capitalised) accepts it, if it is a UniMorph lemma or form, or if it occurs (in lower case, in cased scripts) in a Bible translation
